title: WRONG_SIG_B64: clarify what is corrupted
description: In did_verify.rs tests, WRONG_SIG_B64 is described only as 'wrong' with no indication of what was changed. A new reader cannot tell whether this represents a wrong key, wrong format, or a bit-flip without diffing the two constants manually. The constant should be renamed or have a comment explaining it is TEST_SIG_B64 with the final base64url character changed (last byte of signature flipped).
